title: Towards Generalizing Pretrained All-Atom Representations to Unified Binder Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.37994v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: PairFormer-based all-atom models demonstrate strong capabilities in biomolecular binder design. However, existing methods often use all-atom representations for modality-specific binder design, such as protein and peptide design. In contrast, recent geometric latent diffusion models pursue unified binder design by representing molecular blocks from different modalities in a shared latent space. These complementary strengths motivate us to investigate how to generalize the use of pretrained all-atom representations to unified binder design. We introduce PairFuse, a parameter-efficient method that enables this generalization through representation fusion. Specifically, we use lightweight layerwise adapters to integrate pretrained all-atom representations into an independently pretrained geometric latent diffusion model. translated_title: 迈向将预训练全原子表示泛化至统一结合剂设计
translated_abstract: 基于PairFormer的全原子模型在生物分子结合剂设计中展现出强大的能力。然而，现有方法通常将全原子表示用于特定模态的结合剂设计，例如蛋白质和肽的设计。相比之下，近期的几何潜空间扩散模型通过在共享潜空间中表示来自不同模态的分子块，追求统一的结合剂设计。这些互补的优势促使我们研究如何将预训练全原子表示的应用泛化到统一结合剂设计中。我们提出了PairFuse，这是一种通过表示融合实现这种泛化的参数高效方法。具体而言，我们使用轻量级的逐层适配器将预训练的全原子表示整合到独立预训练的几何潜空间扩散模型中。我们的适配器通过两种机制整合预训练的全原子表示：丰富扩散模型的分子……
tldr: 提出PairFuse方法，通过轻量级逐层适配器将预训练全原子表示融合到几何潜空间扩散模型中，以参数高效的方式实现跨模态的统一结合剂设计。
en_tdlr: Proposes PairFuse, a parameter-efficient method that fuses pretrained all-atom representations into a geometric latent diffusion model via lightweight layerwise adapters, enabling unified cross-modality binder design.
